tools.name: extract_page
tools.description: Fetch one public static web page and extract structured data from it (text, attr, list, table, price, events, page, links, json). Free tier: 30 calls per day per client. No JavaScript rendering.

tools.name: watch_page
tools.description: Create a monitor that checks a public page on a schedule and records changes. Returns monitor id, manage token (shown once), feed and events URLs. Free plan: checks every 60 minutes or slower, 3 active monitors per client, 30 days.

tools.name: get_changes
tools.description: Read the latest state and the change log of a monitor by id.
